items.source: The fetch size controls how much resulting rows will be retrieved simultaneously (the goal being to avoid loading too many results in memory for queries yielding large results). Please note that while value as low as 1 can be used, it is highly discouraged to use such a low value in practice as it will yield very poor performance.
items.translation: fetch size 控制同时检索的结果行数（目标是避免为产生大量结果的查询在内存中加载过多数据）。请注意，虽然可以使用低至 1 的值，但在实践中强烈不建议使用如此低的值，因为这会导致性能极差。
